about.title: About Cresolab
about.subtitle: A Legacy of Trust and Medical Integrity
about.summary:
Established in 2011 in Surat, Gujarat, Cresolab has grown into a premier pharmaceutical manufacturing company. We specialize in developing and producing high-quality formulation products that improve patient lives globally. Our state-of-the-art facility adheres to WHO-GMP standards, ensuring every dosage is safe, effective, and of the highest purity.
✦ Advanced Quality Standards: We operate in strict compliance with international pharmacopoeias (IP/BP/USP) to deliver pristine formulation values across all clinical batches.
❖ Advanced Analytical Assays: We utilize modern chromatography and spectroscopic assays to identify, qualify, and check chemical compound stability prior to market release.
◌ Global Reach: Our formulations are active in over 30 countries, supported by complete CTD/eCTD dossier dossiers for fast foreign Ministry approvals.
▫ Cleanroom Control: We utilize dedicated HVAC air handling units with terminal 99.97% HEPA filters to completely prevent cross-contamination during compaction.
about.mission:
To manufacture and deliver high-quality, affordable healthcare products globally through rigorous research, cutting-edge manufacturing processes, and compliance with national and international quality standards.
✦ Accessibility Focus: Making vital medications affordable to all segments of society, particularly in developing healthcare markets.
❖ Ethical Compliance: Maintaining complete transparency, research integrity, and absolute compliance with GMP codes.
◌ Zero Contamination Goal: Designing processes that protect therapeutic purity and environmental ecosystems near Surat GIDC Sachin.
about.vision:
To become a globally recognized pharmaceutical leader known for formulation innovation, manufacturing excellence, and making advanced healthcare accessible to all segments of society.
✦ Therapeutic Pioneering: Researching Novel Drug Delivery Systems (NDDS) to improve patient dosing frequency and compliance.
❖ Green Chemistry Focus: Transitioning our manufacturing footprint to 100% renewable power and zero liquid discharge systems by 2035.

values.title: Uncompromised Quality
values.description:
Adhering to global standards (WHO-GMP, ISO) across our manufacturing lifecycle.
✦ Compliance Integrity: Continuous monitoring of HVAC air velocities and deionized water loop sanitization to prevent bio-film formation.
❖ Real-time Rejection: Auto-weight calibration systems reject tablets deviating from density specifications, ensuring uniform dosage delivery.

values.title: Scientific Innovation
values.description:
Investing in formulation Research & Development to solve complex clinical needs.
✦ NDDS Breakthroughs: Developing multi-polymer release matrices for anti-diabetic and cardiovascular therapies.
❖ Taste-Masking Systems: Utilizing pH-dependent micro-encapsulation to mask bitter API profiles in pediatric liquids.

values.title: Patient-Centricity
values.description:
Keeping patients at the heart of our operations by ensuring safety, efficacy, and affordability.
✦ Safety Profiles: Complete validation profiles (Zone IVb stability) ensure shelf-life potency in hot/humid climates.
❖ Accessible Medicine: Cost-efficient generic engineering providing identical therapeutic behavior to brand reference drugs.

values.title: Absolute Integrity
values.description:
Operating with transparency, ethical research practices, and regulatory transparency.
✦ CTD Dossier Transparency: Compiling audit-ready Module 1 to 5 dossiers supporting seamless registrations with foreign ministries.
❖ Ecological Stewardship: Neutralizing chemical waste on-site, ensuring zero runoff reaches the Surat Sachin municipal network.

rnd.title: Research & Development
rnd.subtitle: Scientific Inquiry for Next-Generation Therapeutics
rnd.description:
At Cresolab, our R&D division is the engine of our growth. Backed by a team of highly qualified scientists, we focus on developing advanced formulations, modifying drug delivery systems, and optimizing manufacturing efficiency. Our facility features advanced HPLC, UV-Vis spectrophotometers, stability chambers (ICH-compliant), and dissolution testing equipment to guarantee molecular integrity from design to release.
✦ Molecular Assays: Our F&D team validates active compound degradation curves under Zone IVb stability profiles.
❖ Particle Engineering: We optimize API dissolution rates via micronization and polymeric surfactant carrier matrices.
◌ Compliance Audits: We maintain absolute traceability, archiving complete validation run dossiers for global registrations.

manufacturing.title: Manufacturing Capabilities
manufacturing.subtitle: State-of-the-Art Production Facility in Surat
manufacturing.description:
Located in the industrial hub of Surat, Gujarat, our world-class manufacturing facility is spread over a sprawling campus designed in accordance with cleanroom Class 100,000 (ISO 8) standards. The facility is equipped with automated high-speed compression machines, capsule filling machines, liquid filling lines, and Alu-Alu blister packaging lines, reducing human contact and ensuring sterile integrity.
✦ High Output: Compacting over 50 million oral solid doses annually with real-time compression force monitors.
❖ Sterile Water Loops: Running continuous 80°C deionized purified water circulation to prevent bacterial bio-film growth.
◌ Cleanroom Pressure: Establishing +15 Pascal differential corridors to completely eliminate cross-contamination during product runs.

keySections.title: Oral Solids Block
keySections.description:
Capacity to manufacture millions of tablets and capsules daily with multi-station compression and auto-coating.
✦ Process Controls: Integrated magnetic metal detectors and automatic reject gates.
❖ Composite Blisters: Alu-Alu and PVC/PVdC blister packaging blocks kept below 35% relative humidity to protect moisture-sensitive APIs.

keySections.title: Liquid Orals Block
keySections.description:
Equipped with automated manufacturing vessels, filtration, and high-speed packaging lines for syrups and suspensions.
✦ Sterile Loops: double-pass reverse osmosis (RO) loops running continuously at 80°C to completely prevent microbial growth.
❖ Taste Masking: Reconstitutable dry syrup mixers utilizing micro-encapsulated taste-barrier particles.

keySections.title: Quality Control Lab
keySections.description:
An independent, fully-equipped testing lab running chemical, instrumental, and microbiological audits at every batch step.
✦ HPLC Systems: High-precision computerized chromatography verifying chemical purity and assay profiles.
❖ Accelerated Chambers: Stability chambers validating shelf-life decay rates matching ICH Zone IVb protocols.

globalMarkets.description:
Cresolab is an expanding export presence. Our formulations are registered and exported to over 30 countries across Southeast Asia, Africa, and Latin America. We comply with CTD/eCTD dossier standards to support seamless registrations with foreign Health Ministries.
✦ Dossier Readiness: Providing complete Module 3 (CMC) files and bioequivalence studies for regional health authorities.
❖ Cold-Chain Logistics: Shipping liquid suspensions in actively monitored reefer containers to protect drug molecule structures.
◌ Ministry Registrations: Holding active MoH, NAFDAC, NMRA, and PPB approvals across multiple generic markets.

sustainability.summary:
At Cresolab, we believe in 'Responsible Therapeutics'. We align our production capacity in Surat with strong Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) standards to minimize our carbon footprint and preserve natural resources.
✦ Renewable Grid: Rooftop 250kW solar panel grid offsets up to 45% of peak manufacturing power needs in Sachin GIDC.

news.title: Cresolab exhibits at CPHI India 2026
news.summary: We showcased our newly validated pediatric suspensions and advanced cardiovascular blister formulations at CPHI India. The team held discussions with distribution partners from East Africa and CIS regions.
news.body:
Cresolab successfully showcased its next-generation formulation portfolio at the CPHI India 2026 exhibition.
✦ Core Showcase: The analytical team highlighted our newly formulated taste-masked pediatric oral drops and high-bioavailability cardiovascular bilayer tablets.
❖ Partner Engagements: We conducted detailed technical reviews with over 45 international trade desks, focusing on regulatory dossier availability for regional registrations.
◌ Strategic MOUs: Signed letters of intent with prominent distribution partners from Kenya, Nigeria, and Uzbekistan, establishing long-term supply pipelines.
▫ Quality Validation: Our directors presented batch stability profiles (Zone IVb) validating molecule stability under extreme relative humidity and temperature conditions, satisfying high-barrier generic requirements.

news.title: Rooftop Solar Grid Commissioned at Sachin GIDC
news.summary: As part of our commitment to carbon-neutral production, Cresolab successfully commissioned a 250kW solar panel grid on the roofs of our oral solids manufacturing building in Surat, Gujarat.
news.body:
Cresolab has achieved a major ESG milestone with the successful commissioning of a 250kW monocrystalline solar photovoltaic grid on the roofs of our main oral solid dosage block in Sachin GIDC, Surat.
✦ Carbon Reduction: This clean energy deployment offsets approximately 220 metric tons of CO2 equivalent annually.
❖ Grid Offset Capacity: During peak daylight operations, the solar panels satisfy up to 45% of the compression block's total electrical demand.
◌ ESG Framework: Part of a multi-year project to integrate clean technology across our manufacturing facilities in Gujarat, decreasing dependence on local fossil-fuel utility grids.
▫ Continuous Tracking: Our operations desk features a live digital panel tracking daily energy generation, performance metrics, and carbon offset levels.

news.title: Cresolab enters Latin American Generic markets
news.summary: Following successful dossier approvals from regulatory ministries in Peru and Ecuador, Cresolab has dispatched its first export shipment of cardiovascular and anti-diabetic formulations to Latin America.
news.body:
We are proud to announce Cresolab's official entry into the Latin American generic formulations market, following successful regulatory reviews and approvals from Health Ministries in Peru and Ecuador.
✦ Dossier Approval: Registrations were obtained under full eCTD format filings (Modules 1 to 5), including bioequivalence study data matching local reference standards.
❖ First Shipment: The initial export batch, comprising over 1.2 million doses of cardiovascular and anti-diabetic formulations, has been dispatched from Surat.
◌ Cold-Chain Shipping: The transport utilized active temperature-controlled maritime containers equipped with automated telemetry data loggers to protect molecule integrity.
▫ Market Expansion: Our business development division is currently filing subsequent dossiers in Colombia and Chile, expanding our global pharmaceutical footprint.

news.title: Successful WHO-GMP Re-audit of Tablet Block
news.summary: Our primary oral tablet compression and auto-coating cleanrooms completed the annual WHO-GMP renewal audit with zero critical observations, reinforcing Cresolab's uncompromised commitment to quality.
news.body:
Cresolab's main oral solids manufacturing block has successfully cleared its annual WHO-GMP re-audit conducted by regional drug authorities, completing the inspection with zero critical observations.
✦ Cleanroom Class Validation: The audit validated our Class 100,000 (ISO Class 8) differential pressure regimes and HVAC filtration efficiencies.
❖ Process Calibration: Evaluated computerized compression force monitoring systems, proving high uniformity of tablet weight and API distribution.
◌ Sterile Water Loops: Checked microbial count swap tests and chemical assays on our purified deionized water loops, verifying zero bacterial biofilms.
▫ Regulatory Assurance: The successful renewal guarantees product compliance and maintains active status for export dossier registration globally.

news.title: R&D Team Publishes Study on Pediatric Taste Masking
news.summary: Cresolab's formulation research division published a paper detailing innovative micro-encapsulation methods for taste masking bitter antibiotic APIs.
news.body:
The Research and Development team at Cresolab has published a peer-reviewed research paper in the International Journal of Pharmaceutics, showcasing our proprietary formulation technology.
✦ Active Taste Masking: The paper details our use of pH-dependent polymer matrix micro-encapsulation to mask the taste of bitter antibiotic APIs in oral dry syrups.
❖ In-Vivo Dissolution: Demonstration of how micro-capsules remain stable in the mouth's neutral pH but dissolve rapidly in stomach acid (pH 1.2).
◌ Pediatric Adherence: This formulation design significantly improves compliance rates in young patients, ensuring exact dosage absorption.
▫ Open Science: By sharing these findings, Cresolab supports generic formulation advancements while securing our intellectual property for matrix coating processes.

news.title: High-Speed Blister Pack Line Commissioned
news.summary: We have expanded our packaging facility by commissioning a high-speed blister packing line equipped with automatic micro-crack camera detectors.
news.body:
Cresolab has boosted its primary packaging output by commissioning a new, fully automated high-speed blister packaging line in our Surat facility.
✦ High Output: The line handles both Alu-Alu and PVC/PVdC composite packaging at speeds of up to 300 blisters per minute.
❖ Optical Camera Inspections: Features 3D optical cameras checking every pocket for micro-cracks or thickness anomalies, rejecting defects automatically.
◌ Moisture Protection: Ideal for packaging moisture-sensitive molecules, maintaining cleanroom relative humidity levels below 35%.
▫ Scale-Up: This expansion doubles our packaging throughput, supporting growing export demand from international distributor networks.

news.title: Strategic Partnership for European eCTD Pipeline
news.summary: Cresolab has signed a partnership agreement with regulatory consultants to compile generic dossiers for upcoming European health authority filings.
news.body:
Cresolab is planning to enter advanced regulated markets by signing a strategic regulatory alliance with leading European pharmaceutical consultants.
✦ eCTD Compliance: The partnership focuses on translating Sachin GIDC batch data, process validation logs, and impurities studies into European eCTD format.
❖ Target Molecules: Initial dossiers will cover high-potency oral solids in the Anti-Diabetic and Neurological therapeutic areas.
◌ Laboratory Upgrades: Our Surat facility is undergoing supplemental audits to align analytical laboratory workflows with European GMP guidelines.
▫ Long-term Expansion: This regulatory step lays the groundwork for launching cost-effective generic formulations in Western Europe by 2028.

news.title: ZLD Facility Reaches 1,000 Days of Operations
news.summary: Our closed-loop Zero Liquid Discharge wastewater purification plant has successfully completed 1,000 consecutive days of clean, leak-free operations.
news.body:
Cresolab's environmental team celebrates 1,000 consecutive days of operational excellence at our Sachin GIDC Zero Liquid Discharge (ZLD) purification facility.
✦ Water Recycling: The plant has successfully treated and recycled over 15 million liters of chemical rinse and laboratory wastewater runoff.
❖ closed-loop MVR: Uses Mechanical Vapor Recompression to evaporate wastewater, returning pure condensate to boiler utility loops and capturing dry chemical salts.
◌ Zero Soil Impact: Ensures that no industrial wastewater exits our manufacturing perimeter, protecting Surat's soil and water tables from contamination.
▫ Regulatory Standard: Fully compliant with the Gujarat Pollution Control Board, demonstrating that clean manufacturing is viable at mass pharmaceutical scale.
